body:
ASHMAW
CR 8

XP 4,800
CE Medium outsider (extraplanar)
Init +2, Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +13

DEFENSE

AC 24, touch 12, flat-footed 22 (+2 Dex, +6 armor, +6 natural)
hp 85 (10d10 +30)
Fort +13, Ref +5, Will +8 DR 5/-; Immunities charmed, fear effects, fire; SR 19

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee bite +15/10 (2d6 +10)

STATISTICS

Str 20, Dex 15, Con 14, Int 12, Wis 13, Cha 13
Base Atk +11; CMB +18, CMD 30
Feats Toughness, Power Attack

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Ashen Aura (Su)

The air a round the ashmaw is constantly superheated. Grass curls and turns to ash in seconds if it is nearby. Creatures within 5 feet of the ashmaw suffer 1d6 fire damage every round at the start of each of its turns.

Pyroclastic Breath (Su)

The ashmaw exhales choking, burning ash in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 18 Reflex saving throw, taking 5d8 fire damage and 5d8 negative energy damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The ashmaw can use its breath weapon once every 1d4 rounds.
